1) The current Covid 19 outbreak is likely to lead to a considerable increase in the prevalence and intensity of anxiety and depressive symptoms in people who do not currently have a mental health disorder.
1. People with mental illness are at increased risk of contracting Covid 19, of experiencing difficulties in accessing testing and treatment, and of negative physical and mental health outcomes.
1. People with pre-existing mental health and substance disorders are at increased risk of contracting Covid 19, and of having problems accessing treatment
